1. **Keep a consistent sleep schedule.** Go to bed and wake up at the same times every day, even on weekends. This trains your circadian rhythm so your body knows when to wind down.

2. **Make your bedroom cool, dark, and quiet.** A temperature around 65–68 °F (18–20 °C), blackout curtains or an eye mask, and minimal noise signal to your brain that it's time to sleep and help you stay asleep through the night.
